notAvailable.what: Age split of each platform audience in Qatar
notAvailable.why: DataReportal publishes gender, not age, per platform for Qatar. Age by platform is visible only inside each ad tool (Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Snapchat Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads) and can be entered here with its source and date.
No public Qatar source publishes interest-level audience sizes. They come from ad tools or paid panels (GWI, Kantar, Statista Consumer Insights) and can be entered here with source and date.
No public source splits each social platform by device for Qatar. Country device and operating-system shares are shown as context, labelled as share of web page views.
The DataReportal Qatar report gives no figure for these.
